_comment: L1 deterministic-check config. Universal stuff (power-symbol filter, refdes pattern, missing-value sentinels, grid) lives in conventions.json. Tier-scalable thresholds (proximity distance, min_pins) are marked with '_tier_key'; at runtime basic_checks.py passes those keys to CircuitProfile.threshold() which resolves the active tier's value from circuit_scale_config.json. Fixed geometry constants (wire tolerances, font metrics) are NOT tier-scaled — they are KiCad/KLC physical constants that don't change with circuit complexity.

reference._comment: Refdes annotation + format severities. The valid format itself comes from conventions.json:refdes.pattern.

value._comment: Severity for blank/placeholder Value fields. Sentinel list in conventions.json:missing_value_sentinels.

label._comment: Net-name rules. orphan_kinds_to_check is tier-driven: empty at nano/small (too noisy), enabled at medium+ when nets.py can walk sheet pins across hierarchy.

_orphan_tier_keys._comment: At which tiers to enable orphan checking. circuit_profile resolves this. nano/small: [] (noisy). medium+: ['label','global_label'].

grid._comment: Off-grid endpoints silently fail to connect. Grid step from conventions.json:grid.schematic_mm.

geometry._comment: Visual cleanliness checks. Fixed geometry constants below are KiCad/KLC physical constants — same regardless of circuit size. Tier-scalable values carry a '_tier_key' pointing to circuit_scale_config.json:thresholds.

wire_overlap._comment: tolerance_mm and overlap_min_mm are KiCad floating-point drift constants — NOT tier-scaled.

label_collision._comment: coord_tolerance_mm is a floating-point snap constant — NOT tier-scaled.

symbol_proximity._comment: Coarse fallback. min_separation_mm IS tier-scaled via 'min_separation_tier_key'.

symbol_bbox_overlap._comment: Real bbox-vs-bbox check. fallback_size_mm and min_overlap_area_mm2 are physical KLC constants — NOT tier-scaled.

wire_through_body._comment: interior_margin_mm and min_body_dim_mm are KLC S3.5 physical constants — NOT tier-scaled.

net_dangling_label._comment: kinds_to_check is resolved from label._orphan_tier_keys at runtime via CircuitProfile. min_endpoints is a logical constant (1 = at least one electrical pin on the net).

junction_missing._comment: coord_tolerance_mm is a floating-point snap constant — NOT tier-scaled.

label_over_wire._comment: All values here are KiCad font metrics (KLC S3.2, KiCad label_offset_ratio=0.15). Physical constants — NOT tier-scaled. Changing them would misrepresent what KiCad actually renders.

functional._comment: L3 functional checks. Tier-scalable values carry a '_tier_key'; basic_checks.py resolves them via CircuitProfile.threshold() at call time.

decoupling_proximity._max_distance_comment: Resolved at runtime from circuit_scale_config.json:thresholds.proximity_per_pin_radius_mm via CircuitProfile.threshold_float('proximity_per_pin_radius_mm'). Value below is the static fallback used only when CircuitProfile is unavailable (e.g. standalone basic_checks call without schematic path).
